payload.reason: The evidence provides a comparison of the adaptively sparse Transformer method against standard softmax and other baseline models, highlighting performance metrics and characteristics.

claims.text: Replacing softmax with entmax does not hurt performance; sparse attention Transformers tend to have slightly higher BLEU scores.
The adaptively sparse Transformer improves interpretability and head diversity compared to softmax Transformers, with heads learning different sparsity preferences.
The end-to-end computational overhead of the adaptively sparse methods is relatively small, achieving 75% to 90% of the speed of the softmax model.
